278670825.description: This listing features two vintage Danish tobacco pipes crafted by Karl Erik and Jules. The Karl Erik pipe is made of smooth, natural brown briar wood with a freehand shape and is marked 'HAND CUT IN DENMARK 5'. The Jules pipe has a partially rusticated finish with a dark brown color and a bent stem, marked 'HAND CUT IN DENMARK'. Both pipes show signs of darkening in the bowls and surface wear, with one pipe missing its stem. These pipes exhibit distinct artisan craftsmanship and are suitable for collectors or restoration.

278583040.description:
Educational fossil specimen set from Dancing Bear, marked Fossil Collection 12 Genuine Specimens on the box. Each specimen comes in a resealable bag with a printed information card naming the fossil and describing it. Bagged specimens include Coral, Crinoid, Dinosaur bone, Coprolite, Brachiopod, Orthocereas, Gastropod, Clam, two Shark tooth bags, Trilobite and Ammonite. Also included are the printed Fossil Identification Guide booklet, the white cardboard storage box, and two loose unbagged stone specimens. A good starter set for classroom or collector display.

Condition: Light shelf wear and edge scuffing on the box and booklet. Two specimens are loose outside of bags. Bags and cards show minor creasing.

279203873.description: This lot includes four vintage collectible items: a brass letter opener shaped like a reclining nude woman; a Miami, Florida souvenir letter opener with an ornate handle featuring a snake wrapped around a column and an alligator emblem; a vintage wooden smoking pipe with a dark brown bowl and black stem; and a vintage orange dip pen with a metal nib marked 'Koh-I-Noor No. 132 Germany.' All items show signs of age and use, including patina and wear on metal surfaces and residue in the pipe bowl. These mid-20th century items are suitable for display or as additions to vintage desk accessory or tobacciana collections.

278872619.description:
Petrified Wood and Agate Specimen Lot
Mineral Specimen Lot - 2 Pieces
Polished and Natural, Brown and Tan, Vintage
This mineral collector's lot features two distinct geological specimens showcasing the beauty of silicified minerals. The first is a rectangular block of polished banded stone, possibly jasper or agatized petrified wood, featuring rhythmic wavy bands of sienna, tan, and cream with a translucent agate corner. The second is a natural rough specimen of petrified wood showing dark internal wood-grain patterns and a characteristic stone-hard fossilized texture.
Polished block displays intricate wavy banding and a translucent agate section at one end
Rough specimen exhibits dark carbon-rich fossilized wood grain and bark-like outer texture
Heavy stone-hard composition consistent with silica-replaced fossilized material
Polished block measures approximately 7 inches in length; total lot weight 2 pounds
Condition:
The polished block shows minor surface scratches and a small chip along one edge consistent with vintage display. The rough specimen remains in its natural state with jagged edges and exposed fossilized grain. No significant structural cracks observed. Finish on the block remains glossy despite light wear.
Thank you for all of your support!
